passage:
A new app helped people remember names, birthdays, and tasks. It sent reminders before important dates.
Amy used it for everything. It reminded her to call her grandmother, water plants, and return books. Her life became more organized.
One day, the app stopped working after an update. Amy missed a friend's birthday and felt terrible.
She realized she had placed all her memory outside herself. After that, she still used the app, but she also wrote important dates on a paper calendar.
Digital tools are helpful servants but poor masters. When people depend on them completely, a small failure can create a large silence.
